problems.reason: Sentence 3 discusses Notocaiman stromeri, a species of a different genus, as if it were an Eocaiman species, which is about a different taxon.

Sentence 9 claims Eocaiman species ranged from the Early Paleocene to the Miocene (ending ~5.3 Ma), yet it limits the time span to the Tortonian (≈11 Ma). Sentence 10 lists species ages only up to the Eocene, contradicting the stated Miocene presence.
